items.title: Applied Digital signs $5.4 billion 18-year AI data-center lease and closes $300 million bridge financing
items.summary: Applied Digital announced a 150 MW, 18-year hyperscaler lease representing about $5.4 billion in contracted base-term revenue, taking its lease portfolio above $41 billion. It also closed a $300 million one-year secured bridge loan for its Louisiana data-center campus. Premarket shares rose approximately 13.4% at 8:02 a.m. ET. Contracted revenue is not delivered capacity, and construction, grid access and financing risks remain.

observations.label: Official company announcement, Nov 23, 8:00 AM EST
observations.value: 18-year lease for 150 MW critical IT capacity with tier-one investment-grade hyperscaler; approximately $5.4B base-term contractual revenue, or ~$12.7B if all renewal options exercised; total portfolio contracted base revenue over $41B

observations.label: Financial facility, company press release Nov 23
observations.value: $300M senior secured delayed-draw bridge facility for Delta Forge 1, Louisiana; 364-day maturity at SOFR + 300 basis points; project collateral and conditions; additional financing required

observations.label: Premarket indicative market move, Nov 23 8:02 AM EST, StockTitan
observations.value: APLD approximately +13.40% versus Nov 20 regular-session close; premarket indication only; no confirmed Nov 23 closing price

observations.label: Fundamental importance
observations.value: Long-term hyperscaler contracting supports lease revenue visibility but requires grid-connected, completed, operational facilities; contracted value is not current income

observations.label: Risks, invalidation, next indicators
observations.value: Follow utility rate approvals and energization milestones, completion funding, debt refinancing, construction schedule, tenant credit and concentration, live MW utilization and regular-session market reaction; delays or lost lease would undermine thesis

items.key_finding: A new $5.4B AI infrastructure lease strengthens contracted demand while a 364-day $300M loan emphasizes execution and refinancing risk.

sources.title: Applied Digital 150 MW lease release, November 23
Applied Digital official $300M bridge facility release

items.title: Kymera reports significant Phase 2b KT-621 eczema results; shares surge in premarket
items.summary: Kymera's 244-patient BROADEN2 Phase 2b trial met primary and secondary endpoints for once-daily oral STAT6 degrader KT-621. At week 16, middle-dose patients had a 72% mean eczema-severity reduction versus 27% for placebo; Kymera plans Phase 3 in 2027. Shares rose around 32.7% at 8:02 a.m. ET premarket. Results are company-reported clinical data, not approval or Phase 3 validation.

observations.label: Official trial disclosure, Nov 23 7:00 AM EST
observations.value: BROADEN2 randomized blinded Phase 2b, N=244, 16 weeks; all doses met primary and secondary endpoints versus placebo

observations.label: Middle-dose Week 16 efficacy versus placebo
observations.value: Mean EASI improvement 72% vs 27% (placebo-adjusted 45 percentage points, p<0.0001); EASI-75 responders 62% vs 22%; itch response improvement also significant

observations.label: Premarket indicative price, 8:02 AM EST November 23
observations.value: KYMR +32.69% from Nov 20 cash close per StockTitan; Barron's independently reports +29.4% at a separate intraday observation; not a settlement close

observations.label: Safety and development
observations.value: Company says well tolerated over 16 weeks; conjunctivitis in 13.1% of middle-dose cohort; Phase 3 first trial targeted mid-2027 subject to regulators; longer-term durability unknown

observations.label: Risks, invalidation, next indicators
observations.value: Monitor full trial publication, detailed adverse events and long-term extension, regulatory Phase 3 alignment, payer/access outlook, Phase 3 replication and efficacy-versus-safety relative to available biologics

items.key_finding: Strong reported placebo-controlled Phase 2b results support an oral Type-2 inflammation drug candidate, but late-stage efficacy and safety are not established.

sources.title: Kymera official BROADEN2 Phase 2b results, November 23
StockTitan Nov 23 8:02 AM premarket KYMR move

items.title: Fresh shipping-flow proxies flag renewed Hormuz stress despite weaker crude futures
items.summary: Wall Street Journal reporting on November 23 says Hormuz transits in the week to November 21 were 42% below prewar levels, and QuantCube's Fujairah inflow proxy was 67% below its October peak. Earlier Financial Times/Kpler reporting corroborates the direction of weakening tanker flows, not those exact measures. Brent and WTI futures fell Monday morning. Neither proxy establishes a verified incremental loss of exported crude.

observations.label: Shipping flow indicator, week ended November 21 (WSJ reporting)
observations.value: Hormuz vessel transits approximately 42% below prewar baseline; methodology/baseline differ from UKMTO vessel movement counts

observations.label: Oil-flow proxy, QuantCube cited by WSJ Nov 23
observations.value: Oil inflows to Fujairah 67% below their October peak; this is a proxy for waterborne flows, not independently verified crude exports or unobserved dark transits

observations.label: Directional cross-check, FT/Kpler Nov 21 article
observations.value: Week ending Nov 18: 263 vessels vs 308 previous week; oil tanker passages 37 vs 52; preliminary flow data second week Nov nearly half first week, subject to late classification

observations.label: Indicative Monday oil futures, WSJ morning report, no settlement
observations.value: Brent ~$91.05/bbl (-1.7%); WTI ~$82.17 (-1.5%). Prices reflect broader supply-surplus outlook and geopolitics; specific quote time not stated

observations.label: Risks, invalidation, next indicators
observations.value: Watch independent Kpler/Vortexa export loadings, AIS dark transit reconciliation, UKMTO/MARAD advisories, war-risk insurance/freight, refinery damage and next Brent/WTI settlement; rebound in reconciled crude exports or sustained safe transit would weaken warning

items.key_finding: New reported Gulf transit and Fujairah proxies suggest shipping deterioration, not a confirmed incremental physical crude-export loss.

sources.title: Wall Street Journal Nov 23 oil and shipping flow report
Financial Times / Kpler Nov 21 oil flow and tanker traffic

items.title: CrowdStrike confirms $43.9 billion all-stock acquisition of Zscaler
items.summary: CrowdStrike and Zscaler signed a definitive all-stock agreement valued at $43.9 billion, offering 1.135 CrowdStrike shares for each Zscaler share. The implied premium is 34% to Zscaler's November 20 close. CrowdStrike reported 28% quarterly revenue growth and $6.26 billion ARR. Premarket reactions favor Zscaler, but integration, dilution and regulatory approval remain significant risks.

observations.label: Official announcement, Nov 23 2026
observations.value: Definitive $43.9B all-stock agreement; 1.135 CRWD shares per ZS share; $260.41 implied per ZS share at Nov 20 CRWD close; ~34% premium; board-approved, not completed

observations.label: Early Nov 23 premarket reaction (not closing prices)
observations.value: Associated Press reported CRWD approximately -7.4%, ZS approximately +18.6%; time-sensitive premarket indications, not confirmed settlement

observations.label: Fundamental context
observations.value: CrowdStrike Q3 FY27 revenue $1.58B, +28% YoY; ARR $6.26B, +27% YoY; net new ARR $419M; combined company expected over $10B annual recurring revenue

observations.label: Completion and conditions
observations.value: Expected H2 CrowdStrike FY2028; subject to ZS shareholder approval, regulatory clearances and customary conditions; companies remain independent until close

observations.label: Risks, invalidation and indicators
observations.value: Track integration/cross-sell progress, overlap and customer churn, dilution, regulatory review, combined margin/free cash flow outlook, shareholder vote, deal spread and regular-session prices; failed approvals or declining recurring revenue would undermine thesis

items.key_finding: A confirmed $43.9B cyber-platform merger materially reshapes endpoint and zero-trust security, with large strategic opportunity and integration risk.

sources.title: SEC filed merger press release, Nov 23
Associated Press Nov 23 U.S. futures and premarket reaction

items.title: KOSPI closes down 3.31% while Taiwan TAIEX rebounds 2.16% after stabilization measures
items.summary: South Korea's KOSPI closed November 23 down 3.31% at 4,708.54, with 824 decliners against 71 gainers, despite announced market support. Taiwan's TAIEX rose 2.16% to 36,811.89, with TSMC gaining around 2%. The divergent closes suggest region-specific liquidity stress rather than uniform semiconductor weakness. Policy measures do not establish improved underlying AI demand.

observations.label: Nov 23 KOSPI regular-session close, Yonhap and MoneyToday
observations.value: 4,708.54, -161.42 points (-3.31%); session low 4,586.80; 824 decliners versus 71 advancers; Korea stabilization fund prepared but deployment not confirmed

observations.label: Nov 23 Taiwan TAIEX regular-session close, Trading Economics and Financial News
observations.value: 36,811.89, +2.16% (~+779 points); TSMC +2.0%; short-sale restriction effective Nov 23; independent closing figures agree within rounding

observations.label: Fundamental significance
observations.value: Semiconductor selloff diverges geographically amid government liquidity responses; does not by itself prove deterioration in HBM, foundry orders or AI capex

observations.label: Risks and next indicators
observations.value: Track foreign flows, market breadth, stabilization fund deployment, TSMC and memory order guidance, chip earnings revisions, credit conditions and next sessions; sustained Korean breadth recovery would weaken liquidity-stress signal

items.key_finding: Confirmed Monday closes show Korea semiconductor-market stress persisting while Taiwan rebounded, an important cross-market divergence.

sources.title: MoneyToday November 23 KOSPI breadth and close
Taiwan TAIEX close, Trading Economics November 23
